votes.motion: Enter into Closed Meeting for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and for attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter a closed session to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and privileged attorney-client matters.
The Council voted to exit the closed session and return to open meeting.
